title: Candidate mechanisms for controllable backward-time signaling and JANUS history-only calibrator audit
distinction: Quantum time reversal, indefinite order, selected correlations and mathematical P-CTC capacity are not equivalent to an early observer receiving an arbitrary later message.

reviewed_primary_sources.name: Retrocausal Capacity of a Quantum Channel: Communicating through Noisy Closed Timelike Curves
reviewed_primary_sources.practical_gate: Require a physically measurable postselected-CTC map: the paper does not provide a constructible spacetime channel.

reviewed_primary_sources.name: Experimental simulation of postselected closed timelike curves for decoding scrambled quantum information
reviewed_primary_sources.practical_gate: Four-qubit circuit on Quantinuum/IBM; archive ALL shots, test unselected early marginals vs later choice; conditional selected fidelity alone insufficient.

reviewed_primary_sources.name: Closed Timelike Curves via Postselection: Theory and Experimental Test of Consistency
reviewed_primary_sources.practical_gate: Distinguish prescribed conditioning from free sender-controlled outcomes.

reviewed_primary_sources.name: Quantum mechanics near closed timelike lines
reviewed_primary_sources.practical_gate: Specifies a different model than P-CTC; do not assume a software fixed point enacts physical backwards signaling.

reviewed_primary_sources.name: Experimental delayed-choice entanglement swapping
reviewed_primary_sources.practical_gate: Compare early raw records, not postselected two-photon coincidence subgroups.

reviewed_primary_sources.name: Experimental superposition of a quantum evolution with its time reverse
reviewed_primary_sources.practical_gate: Transposing/reversing gate direction is not receipt of user-selected future bytes before the user transmits them.

reviewed_primary_sources.name: Delayed choice experiments: an analysis in forward time
reviewed_primary_sources.kind: analysis of delayed choice and quantum eraser
reviewed_primary_sources.practical_gate: Rules out attributing ordinary delayed coincidence analysis to a physically accessible backward channel.

reviewed_primary_sources.name: Traversable wormhole dynamics on a quantum processor
reviewed_primary_sources.practical_gate: The device implements a toy-code/teleportation simulation, not a past-time receiver.

prioritized_routes.requires: Authorized access to actual quantum processor, randomly chosen future bit B, initial quantum state and early measurement records, entire unfiltered shot log, late postselection identifiers
prioritized_routes.operational_test: Compare P(A|B=0) and P(A|B=1) with B selected only after A was irreversibly committed. Require significantly distinguishable unconditioned early distributions; separately report conditional P(A|B,late selection).
prioritized_routes.claim_if_success: Candidate physical anomalous signaling subject to third-party independence and leakage review, NOT automatically a spacetime CTC or tachyon.

prioritized_routes.route: Photonic delayed-choice entanglement swapping with authenticated late-choice source
prioritized_routes.requires: Research optical lab, timestamped early detectors, delayed future choice using independent QRNG, independent cross-timing audit
prioritized_routes.operational_test: Blind prediction of future setting from early unconditional detection data; lock raw data before late setting

prioritized_routes.requires: Photonic bidirectional apparatus, coherent control, forward-vs-reverse operation-witness
prioritized_routes.operational_test: Can verify genuine time-direction of operation, but must also independently implement a new backward-message witness; cannot use operator-witness violation as message evidence.

prioritized_routes.requires: Actual causal time loop or its experimentally certified physical equivalent
prioritized_routes.operational_test: Sender chooses message after the receiver timestamp; earlier receiver must decode without future classical communication or postselection. No device shown to supply the required causal resource.

historical_data_rules: Only full early.json/future.json/comparison.json triplets; verify SHA, trial identity, timestamps and recomputed match count.
Calibration cutoff is frozen before reading the historical ledger.
Group 12 complete trials into one decision epoch; last four entire trials form independent chronological holdout.
No new candidate or alternative validation group inside an epoch; historical candidates do not use current future target.
Activation requires pre-specified Brier gain >=0.01 against both the raw model and uniform 0.5, PLUS exact binomial p under geometrically allocated alpha.
If any requirement fails or too few trials exist, activation=false and model primary predictions are unchanged.
janus_calibration_implementation.current_model_training_origin: JANUS Ocean v3 real-weather 40-river source run 42125238873

pre_registered_operational_distinction.receiver_output: Immutable earlier single-shot or aggregated bit record at t0, before future choice B.
pre_registered_operational_distinction.sender_input: Independent free late choice of B at t1>t0, hidden from receiver until t1.
pre_registered_operational_distinction.metric: Unselected early-channel capacity / mutual information about B; all shots, not after cherry-picked selection.
pre_registered_operational_distinction.null: Earlier records are independent of future message choices when no physical backward-time channel is present.
pre_registered_operational_distinction.prerequisite: A physically implemented and auditable mechanism connecting B at t1 to the earlier readout at t0.
pre_registered_operational_distinction.statistical_requirements: Independent shot blocks, pre-specified alpha/error controls, held-out replications, full logs and timestamps, leakage audit, and no unsupported postselected-only physical claims.
pre_registered_operational_distinction.calibration_as_separate_goal: Improve probability prediction on genuinely learnable processes; any gain from previous outcomes alone cannot establish retrocausal transmission.
